notes: A new look, designed like an iPhone app: glass buttons, message bubbles with tails, and one purple color for everything you can tap
Suggestions above the message box are picked for you from your Psyche, your goals, what's coming up and the time of day, and they slide in as they change
Ask Ervo to plan tomorrow and get a list you can tap through, then add what you picked to your calendar, even before Ervo knows you
Grocery lists come first, then you pick a store, or tap Other Store Near Me for any store; tick items off as you shop
Ervo learns more about you as you talk, including the music you like, and asks a few easy questions when you're new
Saying no to something Ervo offered now just works
Hey Ervo no longer pauses your music while it waits for its name (Android 13 and newer)
Reset Ervo in the menu starts over like the first time, without signing out
Updates show as a dot on the menu instead of a pop-up when Ervo opens
Icons in Ideas and Stats have depth now: soft light, texture and a glossy edge
Screens slide in from the right and back, and big titles shrink into the top bar as you scroll
A cleaner app icon: same Ervo, without the shadow under his feet
Opens straight to your chat, with no logo screen to wait through
Text follows your phone's text size, up to twice as big, and Ervo follows your phone's Dark mode
Touch and hold Ervo's reply to copy it or ask again
Sign Out now asks first, because it clears your chats from this phone
On Galaxy Z Fold and tablets, your chats stay open beside the conversation
Touch and hold Ervo's icon to talk, start a side chat, or open Ideas or Psyche (Android)
